sar.narrative: On 2016-11-22 at 17:27, card C11891-K1 belonging to customer C11891 was used for an online purchase of $292.36 (product code C), approximately 6x the cardholder's historical average of $47.46 across 44 prior online transactions. No identity record was available for this transaction. The cardholder, when contacted, stated they did not make this purchase. A prior confirmed card-not-present fraud case (CC-4160, $90.54) exists on this same card, indicating a pattern of repeated unauthorized use. The combination of an anomalous amount, customer denial, and prior confirmed fraud on the same card constitutes strong grounds for a suspicious activity report. Card blocked and scheduled for reissue.
